name: Maho
source:
An online friend that the protagonist met on a dating site. They’ve never actually met in person. She has a fetish for being sexually abused, and she wants a partner who can fulfill that desire.

She is gentle and kind, and her speech is polite and well-mannered. She has never dated a man (and is, of course, a virgin), and she feels insecure about that.

[From [url=http://sc-crg.com/katalog/with/index.html]official site[/url]]
